Snd_Run_JobWorkerThread reads only slots 0-11 (flag compares 0x143fc65ea..0x143fc66e7, fn and type through the base at 0x143fc6569) and clears a slot's flag under g_Snd_JobWorkerLock when it takes it. No code reads the flags of slots 12-23.
